repaid_items.description: `PresetResolver` only supported `manual_select` and had no deterministic suggestion path
repaid_items.result: Added deterministic offline `suggest()` while keeping execution explicit

repaid_items.description: `HandoffLite` was frozen only as a contract and not persisted
repaid_items.result: Added persistence plus `status-detail`, `handoffs`, smoke, and offline-validation coverage

repaid_items.description: thin compile existed only as an internal placeholder and not as a public lifecycle surface
repaid_items.result: Added explicit public `compile / recompile / resume` lifecycle surfaces

repaid_items.description: execution initially relied on a shell-only lane with no stable GPT-capable CLI route
repaid_items.result: `WorkerRouter`, multi-route capability selection, adapter pinning, `NoopAdapter`, and `OpenCodeAdapter` now provide a real multi-adapter execution baseline

repaid_items.description: `packages/core_domain/services.py` concentrated too much orchestration, projection, memory, simulation, and lifecycle logic in one file
repaid_items.result: Extracted bounded service modules for projection/reporting, memory/simulation, and lifecycle/review while keeping `OrchestratorService` as the public facade

repaid_items.description: subprocess-backed adapters did not enforce declared timeout budgets and inherited too much parent environment state
repaid_items.result: Added timeout enforcement, subprocess env allowlisting, interpreter-portable compile commands, and explicit local execution trust-boundary docs

repaid_items.description: `infra/scripts/offline_validation.py` had grown into an oversized validation script instead of a modular validation package
repaid_items.result: Split validation flows into `infra/validation/` modules and reduced `offline_validation.py` to a thin entry wrapper

repaid_items.description: runtime-brief and memory-retrieval assembly lacked a hard context-budget preflight and explicit pruning guard path
repaid_items.result: Added diagnostics-first `context_budget`, gateway preflight guarding, trace context, and ADR-006 for the next-step pruning strategy

repaid_items.description: key runtime dependencies were pinned with narrow upper bounds, making routine compatibility and security updates harder than necessary
repaid_items.result: Widened core runtime upper bounds selectively and documented the repository's dependency/versioning policy before `M8`

repaid_items.description: governance reports parsed Markdown debt prose directly instead of consuming a structured canonical source
repaid_items.result: Added canonical JSON governance sources with Markdown compatibility fallback and explicit source-contract reporting

repaid_items.description: clean source-package/export flow was not productized, so review or handoff snapshots could include local state, DBs, artifacts, and repo noise
repaid_items.result: Added source-package manifest/export tooling, minimal automation gates, and freeze-review provenance for handoff claims

repaid_items.description: canonical repo docs mixed local absolute links and current/historical guidance without a portable source map
repaid_items.result: Finished portable-link cleanup for living docs and formalized current-vs-historical doc governance in the active workflow guide

repaid_items.description: review policy breadth stopped at `auto_only`, `recommended`, `human_required`, and `mandatory`; `optional` was reference-only
repaid_items.result: Added executable `optional` advisory-review runtime behavior, seed coverage, and governance/readiness parity

repaid_items.description: `run_events` and trace export lacked replay-grade linkage and first-class run metrics
repaid_items.result: Added replay-packet projection, end-to-end run metrics, and richer audit/status observability surfaces

repaid_items.description: the durable pilot still lacked explicit interrupt/resume/checkpoint lineage and reconciliation semantics
repaid_items.result: Added structured durable lineage history, durable transition inspection, and terminal/review checkpoint reconciliation

repaid_items.description: governance visibility remained document-centric and lacked quantitative automation and alerts
repaid_items.result: Added quantitative governance metrics, automated alert reports, and updated release-readiness integration

repaid_items.description: claim and worker-lease semantics remained local-only and did not provide explicit repository-owned ownership topology
repaid_items.result: Added explicit claim/worker ownership topology, attempt-aware claim and lease linkage, coherent ownership projections, and local batch-domain semantics without turning the runtime into a multi-node scheduler

repaid_items.description: execution semantics were still serial-first and did not implement claim/lease/barrier-aware local batch concurrency
repaid_items.result: Added local batch-barrier events, parallel batch resume semantics, projection surfaces, and CLI/API batch-resume entry points for the supported local control plane

open_items.description: true external worker pools and multi-node scheduling are still not productized beyond the local-first control plane
open_items.blocking_impact: blocks remote worker pools, distributed lease renewal, and hosted scheduler expansion
